text: {"lessons":["My account fell in Periods 6–7 and recovered by Period 9, so I should not react impulsively to short-term swings; I should review decisions against a longer-term plan.","Buying Stock D again increased its weight relative to my other holdings, so I should check concentration and preserve cash before adding to any position.","With no trades in several periods, I still need to review whether my holdings and cash suit my ten-year apartment goal, and make changes only when a clear reason supports them."]}
